stories.title: China strips former generals Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli of top military positions
stories.summary: Beijing has formally removed former senior officers Zhang Youxia and Liu Zhenli as members of China’s supreme military command. The two generals have been under investigation for alleged discipline violations since January and were officially stripped of their positions on the Central Military Commission (CMC) at a meeting of the National People’s Congress’ Standing Committee on Friday. As the CMC’s senior vice-chairman, Zhang was the highest-ranking uniformed officer in the Chinese military....

stories.title: Rock en Seine: Visually impaired spectators enjoy festival with audio description
stories.summary: At Paris's Rock en Seine, visually impaired festival-goers can enjoy concerts through live audio description. The festival is offering dedicated platforms, as well as headphones and receivers provided by the Valentin Haüy Association, a pioneer in audio description in France. Spectators can experience a concert with audio description each day of the music festival, from August 26 to August 30.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces using prohibited phosphorus munitions in Zaporozhye — doctor
stories.summary: The Russian medical unit has received soldiers with severe chemical and thermal burns
article_sentences: /TASS/, The Ukrainian armed forces are using various incendiary weapons in the Zaporozhye area, including those containing phosphorus, Lukas, an intensive care anesthesiologist working at a medical unit in the Zaporozhye Region’s frontline zone, told TASS.
"We have encountered cases of the enemy’s use of prohibited means of warfare.
We have received soldiers with severe chemical burns, thermal burns, in other words, the enemy is using various incendiary weapons: phosphorus and other substances," he said.
Despite the injuries sustained from phosphorus munitions, the Russian soldiers were saved.

stories.title: Lukoil posts 1.5-fold rise in IFRS net profit for 1H
stories.summary: Revenue from sales added 8% to $24 bln
article_sentences: Lukoil’s net profit under the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) attributable to shareholders increased 1.5-fold in 1H 2026 year-on-year to 430.9 bln rubles ($5 bln), the company reported.
Revenue from sales added 8% to 2.06 trillion rubles ($24 bln) compared to 1.9 trillion rubles in the previous year.
Operating profit amounted to 610.9 bln rubles ($7 bln) in the reporting period, up 2.5-fold, while profit before tax climbed more than 3-fold to 581.4 bln rubles ($6.7 bln).
EBITDA grew by more than 34% to 815.3 bln rubles ($9.4 bln) compared to 606.2 bln rubles in the previous year.
